_total_size: 3.6 MB (flat CSV/JSON — appropriate for this scale; no DB needed)
_note: Storage is flat files by design: 3.6 MB loads in <2s. Parquet/DB would add opacity and overhead with no benefit at this scale. Management is handled by this manifest + the validator (validate_data.py), not by a database.

layout.sources/fao_2021/: FAOSTAT 2021 extracts (raw; not read by the model: superseded by CAPRI's own 2017/2030 market data)

base_areas.csv.known_issue: Specialty-crop columns (TOMA, OVEG, and formerly COTT/OLIV/WINE) contain synthetic placeholder values, not observations. COTT and OLIV corrected to real geography. TOMA/OVEG still placeholder — replace with Eurostat apro_cpshr.

animal_numbers.csv.shape_note: 245 -> 248: the three Irish regions (IE04, IE05, IE06) were missing because CAPRI's NUTS-2013 Irish codes did not map onto NUTS-2016. Added by tools/build_ireland.py. The old 245 recorded the defect, not the intended shape.

variable_costs.csv.note: Region x activity matrix, used per-region by the supply model. Crop-specific via CAPRI TOIN-ratio redistribution (group area-weighted means preserved). 39 cells are CALIBRATED rather than observed - see sources/residual_cost_calibration.json.

world_prices.csv.source: CAPRI FAO_agg_17_defaulta p_dataMarket 'World'.'PMRK'.<product>.'BAS' (base-period world market price); per-commodity mapping and previous values in sources/world_price_provenance.json
world_prices.csv.note: Replaced 2026-10: the previous values ('CAPRI SUA') differed from CAPRI's base world prices for most commodities, and the oilseed rows held CAKE prices. OOIL, OLIV, FATS, OFOD_M, WMLK kept (no unambiguous CAPRI counterpart). Sprint 9f: + FRMI, CREM, COCM, WMIO, CASE (CAPRI's dairy products, traded).
world_prices.csv.commodity_set: exactly the market module's 39 traded commodities (definitions.MARKET_COMMODITIES), the same rows as armington_params.csv

trade_flows.csv.note: Recalibrated from CAPRI capmod res_0_1717 (2017). The previous 841-row matrix carried a zero diagonal - no intra-EU trade at all - so every commodity showed a 100% extra-EU import share. 547 rows is fewer because CAPRI reports only realised flows, not an exhaustive grid of zeros. | REBUILT 2026-10 on CAPRI's trade partition (sources/capri_trade_regions_2017.json): no EU or rest-of-world double counting, genuine regions no longer dropped, six oilseed-product columns; EU imports match CAPRI's NONEU rows exactly.

armington_params.csv.note: Sprint 9f: + FRMI, CREM, COCM, WMIO, CASE (CAPRI's dairy products, traded).

supply_elasticities_regional.csv.note: Rebuilt from estnlp PELA 2005 with CAPRI's dampening rule. The previous file was keyed by CAPRI region codes (228 rows, only 107 resolving to model regions) and was clipped at 4.5 rather than dampened, understating 270 cells.

shape.note: real CAPRI crop fertiliser + manure proxy for animals

livestock_output_coef.csv.note: Marketed product per head: CAPRI's COMI/BEEF/PORK/POUM/EGGS/SGMT/SGMI over elementary activities, divided by this model's head count. livestock_revenue_coef.csv.note: Market revenue per head, used instead of price x YILD in livestock net revenue. | Rebuilt 2026-10 with the corrected NUTS correspondence (73 regions now regional CAPRI values).

nutrients_regional.csv.note: Mineral nitrogen applied per hectare by region and crop. NITF is not an application rate; it equals NRET, a requirement.

organic_yield_gap.csv.note: FADN-based organic yield gaps by PESETA macro-region and product group (JRC Seville, SUPREMA).

livestock_intensity_bounds.csv.note: Low- and high-intensity dairy yields: the bounds of the livestock intensity margin.

_vintage_summary.why_not_newer: A newer base requires CAPRI to RE-ESTIMATE its PMP parameters for the new year (a CAPRI-side computation). Mixing newer prices/quantities onto 2017 PMP terms breaks calibration - the validator blocks this. Trade is separable and safely refreshed to 2021.
_vintage_summary.synthetic: 2 files (feed_requirements, nutrient_coefs) have no real source and use plausible templates. Flagged by validator and at runtime.
_vintage_summary.upgrade_path: See docs/DATA_LOCATION_MAP.md. A newer STAR release database (results) from capri-model.org would provide a consistent newer base.
_vintage_summary.layout: Data organised as capri_data/<base_year>/<category>/ with cross-vintage files in shared/. Market JSON parameter files (fao_market_baseline, fao_processing_splits, fao_demand_own_elas_eu) live in <year>/market/.
